lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a repetitive grid-like configuration along the lateral flank, transitioning from smaller, high-density clusters on the anterior head region to larger, more spaced nodes posterior to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible checkerboard lattice across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper lateral flank, defined by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with a light superior edge and a shadowed inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant pixel-level transition in pattern scale between the anterior snout region (small, dense, irregular spots) and the mid-body flank (large, organized, grid-aligned blobs).
